route_witness_mappings.child_source:
proc terminate() { exit 23 }
terminate()
assert "route " + "binary" == "route binary"

let values: List[Any] = [true]
assert values[0].require(Bool)?

let values: List[Any] = [b"route"]
assert values[0].require(Bytes)? == bytes.from_text("route")

proc route_proc_target(value: Int) -> Int { value + 1 }
assert route_proc_target(20) == 21

let raw: UInt = 17
let checked = raw
assert checked == 17

let first = 1
let second = 2
let third = 3
let selected = first < second < third
assert selected == true
assert within 1s { 21 } == Ok(21)

pure route_direct_scale(value: Int) -> Int { value * 3 }
assert route_direct_scale(7) == 21

let values: List[Any] = [2s]
print ${values[0].require(Duration)?}

type RouteScale = pure(value: Int) -> Int
pure route_double(value: Int) -> Int { value * 2 }
let scale: RouteScale = route_double
let handle: Pure = scale
assert handle.call(10).require(Int)? == 20

let empty: Map[Str, Int] = {}
assert empty.len() == 0

let value = ctx "route oracle" { 21 }
assert value == 21

type RouteRenderPlugin = module {export pure render(data: Any) -> Result[Str, Error]}
let root = fs.tempdir()?
defer root.close()?
let plugin_file = fp"{root.host_path()?}/plugin.xsh"
plugin_file.write("##! Expression route plugin.\n## Renders its input.\nexport pure render(data: Any) -> Result[Str, Error] { template.render(\"{{.value}}\", data) }\n")
let plugin = module.load(plugin_file)?.require(RouteRenderPlugin)?
assert plugin.render({value: "external"})? == "external"

let result = error.fail("expected failure")
match result { Err(problem) => assert problem.message == "expected failure"; Ok(_) => assert false }

let values: List[Any] = [1.5]
print ${values[0].require(Float)?}

let word = "formatted"
assert f"route {word}" == "route formatted"

let root = fs.tempdir()?
defer root.close()?
let host_path = root.host_path()?
assert host_path.exists()?

let root = Path(args[0])
cd root { let matches = g"*.txt"; assert matches == [p"match.txt"] }

let selected = if true { "selected" } else { "skipped" }
assert selected == "selected"

proc last(values: List[Str]) -> Str { return values[-1] }
assert last(["first", "last"]) == "last"

let value: Any = 42
print ${value.require(Int)?}

run.status false
let status = $?
assert status.exited_with(1)

let values = [10, 20]
assert values.len() == 2 and values[0] == 10 and values[1] == 20

let doubled = [value * 2 for value in [1, 2, 3]]
assert doubled == [2, 4, 6]

let value = loop { break 21 }
assert value == 21

let entries = {[word]: word for word in ["a", "b"]}
assert entries.get("b")? == "b"

let entries: Map[Int, Str] = {[1]: "one", [2]: "two"}
assert entries.get(2)? == "two"

proc route_match_source() -> Int { return 2 }
assert (match route_match_source() { 2 => 22, _ => 0 }) == 22

let parsed = "17".parse_int()
assert parsed? == 17

type RouteJson = {value: Int}
assert json.decode("{\"value\":21}")?.require(RouteJson)?.value == 21

let values: List[Any] = [null]
assert values[0] is Null

let result = Ok(21)
assert result is Ok(_)

pure identity(value: Duration) -> Duration { value }
assert identity(7s) == 7s

let values: List[Any] = [p"route/oracle"]
assert values[0].require(Path)?.display() == "route/oracle"

let target = Path(args[0])
assert target.du()? >= 0

let executable = Path(args[0])
assert executable.executable()?

let target = Path(args[0])
assert target.exists()?

let name = "entry"
assert fp"root/{name}" == p"root/entry"

let candidate = Path("folder/file")
assert candidate == p"folder/file"

let target = Path(args[0])
assert target.metadata()?.size == 7

let target = Path(args[0])
assert target.read_bytes()? == b"raw\0bytes"

let target = Path(args[0])
assert target.read_text()? == "payload"

let link = Path(args[0])
assert link.readlink()? == p"target"

let target = Path(args[0])
assert target.resolve()?.name() == "entry"

let values = [1, 2, 3] |> map { |value| value * 2 }
assert values.len() == 3 and values[1] == 4

let pattern = rx"^route$"
assert pattern.matches("route")
assert !pattern.matches("router")

let command = process.command_argv("true", ["true"])
assert process.run(command)?.exited_with(0)

let command = process.command { run true }
assert process.run(command)?.exited_with(0)

let values = range(2, 5).collect()
assert values == [2, 3, 4]

let raw: Any = 17
assert raw.require(Int)? == 17

let value = retry [] { 21 }?
assert value == 21

let output = run.capture --text printf "captured"
assert output.stdout == "captured"

let output = run.capture --text printf "piped" | run cat
assert output.stdout == "piped"

pure route_self_count(value: Int) -> Int { if value == 0 { 0 } else { route_self_count(value - 1) + 1 } }
assert route_self_count(1) == 1

let values = [10, 20, 30, 40]
let selected = values[1..3]
assert selected.len() == 2 and selected[0] == 20 and selected[1] == 30

let child = spawn run true?
assert (wait child?).exited_with(0)

let values: List[Any] = ["route"]
print ${values[0].require(Str)?}
assert "é".byte_at(1) == 169
assert "é".byte_len() == 2
assert "alpha".starts_with("al")

let parsed = "21".parse_int()
assert parsed? == 21

type RouteScale = pure(value: Int) -> Int
pure route_direct_scale(value: Int) -> Int { value * 3 }
let scale: RouteScale = route_direct_scale
assert scale(7) == 21

let value = { 20 + 1 }
assert value == 21

let child = spawn run true?
let status = wait child?
assert status.exited_with(0)
